_comment: Home page chips and cards (owner-named chips, 2026-09-09). Card titles/blurbs are copied verbatim from CityAnatomyAustin/src/content/copy.ts; the owner writes all copy. A CARD OPENS ITS WEB APP (`app`) in a new browser window (owner 2026-09-10) - clicking a card no longer changes what plays in the map window. A card with no `app` but a `src` is the old kind and still previews in the window. THE WINDOW PLAYS A DEMO REEL: a chip marked `cycle: true` runs through its cards marked `demo: true` in order, each holding the window for `demoMs` (default 60000) before the next. The demos are animations only - nothing in them responds to a click. A chip may carry its own `src` (News Feed -> /news/): with no cards, picking the chip loads that page in the window. The chip with `open: true` is what the page opens on. A chip may carry `from`: a URL of apps/reports/reports.json shape; home.js turns each report into a card that opens the report's MapLibre map app at /apps/reports/<id>/.
